<project xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
 xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
 xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0
 http://maven.apache.org/maven-v4_0_0.xsd">
 <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
 <artifactId>hitorro-parent</artifactId>
 <packaging>pom</packaging>
 <name>Hitorro</name>
 <!--
 Something that may have details for generating jar files
 http://stackoverflow.com/questions/574594/how-can-i-create-an-executable-jar-with-dependencies-using-maven

 http://today.java.net/pub/a/today/2007/03/01/building-web-applications-with-maven-2.html
 -->
 <parent>
 <groupId>com.hitorro</groupId>
 <artifactId>parent</artifactId>
 <version>3.0.0</version>
 </parent>

 <modules>
 <module>hitorro-all</module>
 <module>thirdpartysource</module>

 <!--<module>numal</module>-->
 </modules>

 <build>
 <pluginManagement>
 <plugins>
 <plugin>
 <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
 <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
 <configuration>
 <source>19</source>
 <target>19</target>
 </configuration>
 </plugin>

 <plugin>
 <artifactId>maven-assembly-plugin</artifactId>
 <version>3.1.0</version>
 <executions>
 <execution>
 <id>make-assembly</id>
 <phase>package</phase>
 <goals>
 <goal>single</goal>
 </goals>
 <configuration>
 <descriptorRefs>
 <descriptorRef>jar-with-dependencies</descriptorRef>
 </descriptorRefs>
 </configuration>
 </execution>
 </executions>
 </plugin>
 </plugins>
 </pluginManagement>
 </build>
</project>

","ranges":[],"type":"current_file"},{"file_path":"MAVEN_COMMANDS.md","code_text":"# Maven Commands Reference

Quick reference for common Maven commands in this multi-module project.

## Building

```bash
# Clean and build all modules
mvn clean install

# Build without running tests (faster)
mvn clean install -DskipTests

# Build only (without cleaning)
mvn install

# Build with verbose output
mvn clean install -X

# Build in parallel (uses multiple threads)
mvn clean install -T 4

# Build specific module and its dependencies
mvn clean install -pl hitorro-base -am

# Build specific module only (no dependencies)
mvn clean install -pl hitorro-base
```

## Testing

```bash
# Run all tests in all modules
mvn test

# Run tests in specific module
mvn test -pl hitorro-base

# Run a specific test class
mvn test -Dtest=MyTestClass

# Run a specific test method
mvn test -Dtest=MyTestClass#testMethod

# Skip tests
mvn install -DskipTests

# Run tests with code coverage
mvn clean test jacoco:report
```

## Dependencies

```bash
# Show dependency tree for all modules
mvn dependency:tree

# Show dependency tree for specific module
mvn dependency:tree -pl hitorro-base

# Analyze dependencies
mvn dependency:analyze

# Show effective POM (with parent inheritance resolved)
mvn help:effective-pom

# Download sources for dependencies
mvn dependency:sources

# Show outdated dependencies
mvn versions:display-dependency-updates
```

## Validation

```bash
# Validate project structure
mvn validate

# Check for duplicate dependencies
mvn dependency:analyze-duplicate

# Verify checksums
mvn verify
```

## Cleaning

```bash
# Clean all target directories
mvn clean

# Clean specific module
mvn clean -pl hitorro-base

# Deep clean (remove all generated files)
mvn clean install -U
```

## Module Operations

```bash
# Build modules in specific order
mvn clean install --projects hitorro-util,hitorro-base

# Resume build from specific module (after failure)
mvn install -rf :hitorro-analysis

# Build only changed modules
mvn install --also-make-dependents

# List all modules
mvn help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.modules -q -DforceStdout
```

## Reactor Build Order

```bash
# Show build order without executing
mvn validate

# The reactor will automatically determine build order based on dependencies
# Output shows the order: util -> base -> text-core -> analysis, etc.
```

## Version Management

```bash
# Show current version
mvn help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -q -DforceStdout

# Update all module versions
mvn versions:set -DnewVersion=3.1.0

# Commit version change
mvn versions:commit

# Revert version change
mvn versions:revert
```

## Package & Deploy

```bash
# Package all modules (creates JARs)
mvn package

# Package with assembly (includes dependencies)
mvn package assembly:single

# Install to local repository
mvn install

# Deploy to remote repository (requires configuration)
mvn deploy
```

## Useful Combinations

```bash
# Quick rebuild without tests
mvn clean install -DskipTests -T 4

# Build and show what changed
mvn clean install -pl '!hitorro-test' -am

# Offline build (use cached dependencies)
mvn clean install -o

# Update snapshots
mvn clean install -U

# Generate documentation
mvn clean install site
```

## Troubleshooting

```bash
# Debug build issues
mvn clean install -X

# Show plugin help
mvn help:describe -Dplugin=compiler

# Show effective settings
mvn help:effective-settings

# Purge local repository cache
mvn dependency:purge-local-repository

# Force re-download of dependencies
mvn clean install -U
```

## Common Flags

- `-am, --also-make` - Build dependencies of specified modules
- `-amd, --also-make-dependents` - Build modules that depend on specified modules
- `-pl, --projects` - Specify module(s) to build
- `-rf, --resume-from` - Resume build from specified module
- `-T` - Build in parallel (e.g., `-T 4` for 4 threads)
- `-U, --update-snapshots` - Force update of snapshots
- `-X, --debug` - Debug output
- `-e, --errors` - Show error stack traces
- `-q, --quiet` - Quiet output
- `-o, --offline` - Work offline
- `-N, --non-recursive` - Don't recurse into sub-modules
- `-DskipTests` - Skip test execution
- `-Dmaven.test.skip=true` - Skip test compilation and execution

## Examples

### Build only hitorro-base and its dependencies
```bash
mvn clean install -pl hitorro-base -am
```

### Build all modules that depend on hitorro-util
```bash
mvn clean install -pl hitorro-util -amd
```

### Quick test of changes in hitorro-analysis
```bash
mvn clean test -pl hitorro-analysis
```

### Full rebuild in parallel
```bash
mvn clean install -T 4

Quick reference for common Maven commands in this multi-module project.

## Building

```bash
# Clean and build all modules
mvn clean install

# Build without running tests (faster)
mvn clean install -DskipTests

# Build only (without cleaning)
mvn install

# Build with verbose output
mvn clean install -X

# Build in parallel (uses multiple threads)
mvn clean install -T 4

# Build specific module and its dependencies
mvn clean install -pl hitorro-base -am

# Build specific module only (no dependencies)
mvn clean install -pl hitorro-base
```

## Testing

```bash
# Run all tests in all modules
mvn test

# Run tests in specific module
mvn test -pl hitorro-base

# Run a specific test class
mvn test -Dtest=MyTestClass

# Run a specific test method
mvn test -Dtest=MyTestClass#testMethod

# Skip tests
mvn install -DskipTests

# Run tests with code coverage
mvn clean test jacoco:report
```

## Dependencies

```bash
# Show dependency tree for all modules
mvn dependency:tree

# Show dependency tree for specific module
mvn dependency:tree -pl hitorro-base

# Analyze dependencies
mvn dependency:analyze

# Show effective POM (with parent inheritance resolved)
mvn help:effective-pom

# Download sources for dependencies
mvn dependency:sources

# Show outdated dependencies
mvn versions:display-dependency-updates
```

## Validation

```bash
# Validate project structure
mvn validate

# Check for duplicate dependencies
mvn dependency:analyze-duplicate

# Verify checksums
mvn verify
```

## Cleaning

```bash
# Clean all target directories
mvn clean

# Clean specific module
mvn clean -pl hitorro-base

# Deep clean (remove all generated files)
mvn clean install -U
```

## Module Operations

```bash
# Build modules in specific order
mvn clean install --projects hitorro-util,hitorro-base

# Resume build from specific module (after failure)
mvn install -rf :hitorro-analysis

# Build only changed modules
mvn install --also-make-dependents

# List all modules
mvn help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.modules -q -DforceStdout
```

## Reactor Build Order

```bash
# Show build order without executing
mvn validate

# The reactor will automatically determine build order based on dependencies
# Output shows the order: util -> base -> text-core -> analysis, etc.
```

## Version Management

```bash
# Show current version
mvn help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -q -DforceStdout

# Update all module versions
mvn versions:set -DnewVersion=3.1.0

# Commit version change
mvn versions:commit

# Revert version change
mvn versions:revert
```

## Package & Deploy

```bash
# Package all modules (creates JARs)
mvn package

# Package with assembly (includes dependencies)
mvn package assembly:single

# Install to local repository
mvn install

# Deploy to remote repository (requires configuration)
mvn deploy
```

## Useful Combinations

```bash
# Quick rebuild without tests
mvn clean install -DskipTests -T 4

# Build and show what changed
mvn clean install -pl '!hitorro-test' -am

# Offline build (use cached dependencies)
mvn clean install -o

# Update snapshots
mvn clean install -U

# Generate documentation
mvn clean install site
```

## Troubleshooting

```bash
# Debug build issues
mvn clean install -X

# Show plugin help
mvn help:describe -Dplugin=compiler

# Show effective settings
mvn help:effective-settings

# Purge local repository cache
mvn dependency:purge-local-repository

# Force re-download of dependencies
mvn clean install -U
```

## Common Flags

- `-am, --also-make` - Build dependencies of specified modules
- `-amd, --also-make-dependents` - Build modules that depend on specified modules
- `-pl, --projects` - Specify module(s) to build
- `-rf, --resume-from` - Resume build from specified module
- `-T` - Build in parallel (e.g., `-T 4` for 4 threads)
- `-U, --update-snapshots` - Force update of snapshots
- `-X, --debug` - Debug output
- `-e, --errors` - Show error stack traces
- `-q, --quiet` - Quiet output
- `-o, --offline` - Work offline
- `-N, --non-recursive` - Don't recurse into sub-modules
- `-DskipTests` - Skip test execution
- `-Dmaven.test.skip=true` - Skip test compilation and execution

## Examples

### Build only hitorro-base and its dependencies
```bash
mvn clean install -pl hitorro-base -am
```

### Build all modules that depend on hitorro-util
```bash
mvn clean install -pl hitorro-util -amd
```

### Quick test of changes in hitorro-analysis
```bash
mvn clean test -pl hitorro-analysis
```

### Full rebuild in parallel
```bash
mvn clean install -T 4

(12 more independent modules)\n│\n└── hitorro-app/ ← Runtime aggregator module\n └── pom.xml (depends on all modules for runtime classpath)\n```\n\n## Module Independence\n\n### Each Sub-Module Is:\n- ✅ **Standalone** - has its own groupId/artifactId/version\n- ✅ **Self-contained** - declares all its own dependencies\n- ✅ **Repository-independent** - can live in separate Git repos\n- ✅ **Reusable** - can be used individually in other projects\n- ✅ **Not coupled to root** - no `<parent>` reference\n\n### The Root POM (`hitorro-root`):\n- ️ **Pure aggregator** - `<packaging>pom</packaging>`\n- **Build convenience** - `mvn install` builds all modules\n- **Dependency suggestions** - `<dependencyManagement>` (optional to use)\n- ❌ **Not a parent** - modules don't inherit from it\n\n### The App Module (`hitorro-app`):\n- **Runtime composition** - bundles modules together\n- **Execution entry point** - configured with main class\n- **Classpath provider** - includes all modules for IntelliJ\n- ⚙️ **Customizable** - edit dependencies to change module set\n\n## Build Modes\n\n### Mode 1: Build All Modules (Reactor Build)\n```bash\ncd /Users/chris/hitorro\nmvn clean install\n```\nMaven builds all modules in dependency order.\n\n### Mode 2: Build Single Module\n```bash\ncd /Users/chris/hitorro/hitorro-util\nmvn clean install\n```\nEach module can be built independently.\n\n### Mode 3: Build App with Dependencies\n```bash\ncd /Users/chris/hitorro/hitorro-app\nmvn clean package\n```\nBuilds the app module and pulls in all module dependencies.\n\n## Usage Patterns\n\n### Pattern 1: Use in Another Project\nAdd only what you need to your external project's POM:\n\n```xml\n<dependencies>\n <dependency>\n <groupId>com.hitorro</groupId>\n <artifactId>hitorro-util</artifactId>\n <version>3.0.0</version>\n </dependency>\n <!-- Add only the modules you need -->\n</dependencies>\n```\n\n### Pattern 2: Run in This Workspace (IntelliJ)\n1. child can't be used without parent\n\n### This Architecture (Aggregator):\n```\naggregator-pom\n ├── (lists modules for build convenience)\n ├── independent-module-1 ──> no parent reference\n └── independent-module-2 ──> no parent reference\n\nruntime-aggregator\n ├── depends on: independent-module-1\n └── depends on: independent-module-2\n```\n**Solution**: Loose coupling - modules stay independent\n\n## Migration Guide\n\nIf you later want to use modules in separate repositories:\n\n1. **Move the module** to its own repository\n2. **Publish to Maven repository** (local or remote)\n3. **Update hitorro-app** to depend on published artifact:\n ```xml\n <dependency>\n <groupId>com.hitorro</groupId>\n <artifactId>hitorro-util</artifactId>\n <version>3.0.0</version>\n <!-- Now fetches from Maven repo instead of local build -->\n </dependency>\n ```\n4. **Remove from root POM** `<modules>` section\n5. **Done** - "},{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Now let me create comprehensive documentation:"}],"tool_calls":[{"id":"call_2FBQJiNznqGAU7tV17m0FlKP","type":"function","function":{"name":"write","arguments":"{"file_path": "/Users/chris/hitorro/MODULE_MANAGEMENT.md", "content": "# Module Management Guide\n\n## Overview\n\nHitorro modules are managed as **independent Git repositories** using shell scripts, **NOT** as Git submodules. This approach:\n- ✅ Keeps each module fully independent and reusable\n- ✅ Allows modules to be used in other projects without Git submodule complexities\n- ✅ Provides simple checkout/update workflows\n- ✅ Maintains clean separation of concerns\n\n## Quick Start\n\n### Initial Setup (Check out all modules)\n\n```bash\n# Clone/update all modules on the 3.0.0 branch\n./checkout-modules.sh\n\n# Or specify a different branch\n./checkout-modules.sh main\n```\n\n### Daily Updates\n\n```bash\n# Pull latest changes for all modules\n./update-modules.sh\n\n# Or specify a different branch\n./update-modules.sh main\n```\n\n## Script Details\n\n### Option 1: checkout-modules.sh (Full Setup)\n\n**Purpose**: Clone missing modules or update existing ones\n\n**Usage**:\n```bash\n./checkout-modules.sh [branch-name]\n```\n\n**Behavior**:\n- If a module doesn't exist: Clones it from Git\n- If a module exists: Stashes local changes, switches to specified branch, pulls updates\n- Provides detailed color-coded output\n\n**Example**:\n```bash\n./checkout-modules.sh 3.0.0\n```\n\n### Option 2: update-modules.sh (Quick Update)\n\n**Purpose**: Update all existing modules (skips cloning)\n\n**Usage**:\n```bash\n./update-modules.sh [branch-name]\n```\n\n**Behavior**:\n- Only processes modules that already exist\n- Stashes local changes, switches to specified branch, pulls updates\n- Simple, quiet output\n\n**Example**:\n```bash\n./update-modules.sh\n```\n\n## Configuring Module URLs\n\nEdit `checkout-modules.sh` to set your actual Git repository URLs:\n\n```bash\nMODULES=(\n \"hitorro-util|https://github.com/geekychris/hitorro-util.git\"\n \"hitorro-base|https://github.com/geekychris/hitorro-base.git\"\n # ... etc\n)\n```\n\nFormat: `MODULE_NAME|GIT_URL`\n\n## Workflow Examples\n\n### Scenario 1: Fresh Development Environment\n\n```bash\n# 1. Clone the hitorro-root repository\ngit clone https://github.com/geekychris/hitorro-root.git\ncd hitorro-root\n\n# 2. Check out all dependent modules on version 3.0.0\n./checkout-modules.sh 3.0.0\n\n# 3. Build the project\nmvn clean install\n\n# 4. Start developing\n# You can now edit any module and they're all available for building\n```\n\n### Scenario 2: Update to Latest Changes\n\n```bash\n# Pull updates for root project\ngit pull origin 3.0.0\n\n# Update all modules\n./update-modules.sh 3.0.0\n\n# Rebuild\nmvn clean install\n```\n\n### Scenario 3: Work on Different Branch\n\n```bash\n# Checkout development branch in all repos\n./checkout-modules.sh dev\n\n# Or update only (if already cloned)\n./update-modules.sh dev\n```\n\n### Scenario 4: Use Only Specific Modules\n\n```bash\n# Skip update scripts - just clone what you need manually\ngit clone https://github.com/geekychris/hitorro-util.git\ngit clone https://github.com/geekychris/hitorro-base.git\n\n# Or use the scripts and delete modules you don't need\n./checkout-modules.sh 3.0.0\nrm -rf hitorro-baseui hitorro-conversation # remove unwanted modules\n```\n\n## Comparison with Git Submodules\n\n| Aspect | This Approach (Shell Scripts) | Git Submodules |\n|--------|-------------------------------|----------------|\n| **Module Independence** | ✅ Fully independent | ⚠️ Coupled to parent repo |\n| **Use in Other Projects** | ✅ Simple clone and use | ❌ Must be submodule or separate clone |\n| **Learning Curve** | ✅ Simple Git operations | ❌ Complex submodule commands |\n| **Performance** | ✅ Standard Git operations | ⚠️ Can be slower |\n| **Merge Conflicts** | ✅ Standard Git merges | ⚠️ Submodule-specific issues |\n| **Version Tracking** | ✅ `.gitmodules` equivalent is the script | ✅ `.gitmodules` |\n| **Partial Checkout** | ✅ Easy (clone only what you need) | ⚠️ More complex |\n| **Repository URL Changes** | ✅ Edit script once | ❌ Must update `.gitmodules` |\n\n## Why Not Git Submodules?\n\nGit submodules create tight coupling and complexity:\n\n### Problems with Git Submodules\n\n1. **Forced coupling**: Modules must be submodules in every project\n ```bash\n # Other projects must use submodules to use your modules\n git submodule add https://github.com/geekychris/hitorro-util.git\n ```\n\n2. **Complex commands**: Special submodule commands required\n ```bash\n git submodule update --init --recursive\n git submodule foreach git pull origin master\n ```\n\n3. **Merge/conflict issues**: Submodule pointer references can be tricky\n ```bash\n # Submodule commits can get out of sync\n # Detached HEAD states common\n ```\n\n4. **Independent usage**: Harder to use modules independently\n ```bash\n # Can't just \"git clone hitorro-util\" and expect it to work nicely\n ```\n\n### Benefits of This Approach\n\n1. **Real independence**: Each module is a standalone Git repository\n ```bash\n # Anyone can clone and use hitorro-util\n git clone https://github.com/geekychris/hitorro-util.git\n cd hitorro-util\n mvn package # Just works!\n ```\n\n2. **Simple Git operations**: No special commands needed\n ```bash\n #  public String getStringValue() {
 if (!hasStringValue()) {
 // this content doesn't content text
 return null;
 }
 try {
 InputStream is = getContent();
 if (is == null) {
 return null;
 }
 InputStreamReader reader = new InputStreamReader(is, StringUtil.UTF8Encoding);
 StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
 int blen = 1024;
 char buffer[] = new char[blen];
 while (true) {
 int read = reader.read(buffer, 0, blen);
 if (read > 0) {
 builder.append(buffer, 0, read);
 }
 if (read < blen) {
 break;
 }
 }
 reader.close();

 return builder.toString();

 } catch (StoreException se) {
 com.hitorro.basedms.Log.basedms.error("Getting content ", se);
 return null;
 } catch (IOException ioe) {
 com.hitorro.basedms.Log.basedms.error("Getting content ", ioe);
 return null;
 }

 }

 *
 * @return

 */
 public boolean createLink() throws IOException {
 File linkFile = getLinkFile();

 BaseFile sf = getStoreFile();
 if (!sf.isLocal()) {
 com.hitorro.basedms.Log.filesystem.error("Attempted to soft link non local file %s to %s", sf, linkFile);
 return false;
 }

 File sfFile = ((FileFile) sf).getJavaFile();
 if (!FileUtil.ensureParentDirectories(linkFile, true)) {
 return false;
 }
 return Platform.getPlatform().softLink(sfFile, getLinkFile());
 }

 /**
 * Get a stream which represents the content the content object contains.
 *
 * @return
 * @throws StoreException
 * @throws FileNotFoundException
 */
 public InputStream getContent()
 throws StoreException, IOException {
 Store store = com.hitorro.basedms.StoreUtil.getStoreByGuid(storeName);
 if (store == null) {
 throw new StoreException("Store not defined for content");
 }

 if (store.getOffline() == true) {
 throw new StoreException(Fmt.S("Store %s offline", store.getName()));
 }

 StoreType st = store.getStoreTypeType();
 if (st == null) {
 com.hitorro.basedms.Log.basedms.error("Content object %s, does not have a store object", this.getId());
 return null;
 }
 switch (st) {
 case Link:
 try {
 URL url = new URL(getOriginalFileName());
 return url.openStream();
 } catch (MalformedURLException e) {
 throw new StoreException(e.getMessage());
 } catch (IOException e) {
 throw new StoreException(e.getMessage());
 }

 case File:
 case Unmanaged:
 Store s = this.getStore();
 BaseFile file = getStoreFile(s);
 if (!BaseFile.notNullAndExists(file)) {
 return null;
 }
 return file.getDataInputStream();

 case Blob:
 try {
 return this.getBlobContent().getBinaryStream();
 } catch (SQLException e) {
 throw new StoreException(e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 return null;
 }

 return getStoreFile(getStore());
 }

 private final BaseFile getStoreFile(Store s) {
 if (internalFile == null) {
 internalFile = s.getRootPathPath().getChild(this.getFileName());
 }
 return internalFile;
 }

 public boolean setContent(String originalFileName, InputStream is, ContentType ct)
 throws StoreException, IOException {
 Store store = setContentBasicParts(originalFileName, ct);

 return setContentAux(store, originalFileName, is);
 }

 private Store setContentBasicParts(String originalFileName, ContentType ct) throws StoreException {
 this.setOriginalFileName(originalFileName);
 this.setContentType(ct);
 Store store = getStore();
 if (store == null) {
 throw new StoreException("Store not defined for content");
 }
 if (store.getOffline() == true) {
 throw new StoreException(Fmt.S("Store %s offline", store.getName()));
 }
 return store;
 }

 private boolean setContentAux(Store store, String originalFileName, InputStream is)
 throws StoreException, IOException {
 StoreType st = store.getStoreTypeType();
 switch (st) {
 case Link:
 throw new StoreException("Cannot set content for a content object with store type of Link");
 case Unmanaged:
 throw new StoreException("Cannot set content for a content object with store type of UnmanagedLink");
 case File:
 long tempID = 0;
 try {
 tempID = ContentIdNamedLong.getNextValue();
 } catch (Exception e) {
 com.hitorro.basedms.Log.basedms.error("%s %e", e, e);
 }
 String fn = FileUtil.idToHexPath(tempID);
 if (store.getIsPubliclyVisible()) {
 // public files need to have a good extension so they can be understood by the client
 String ext = FileUtil.getFileExtension(originalFileName);
 if (!StringUtil.nullOrEmptyOrBlankString(ext)) {
 fn = Fmt.S("%s.%s", fn, ext);
 }
 }
 this.setFileName(fn);
 BaseFile destFile = store.getRootPathPath().getChild(fn);

 if (destFile.mkParentDir()) {
 OutputStream os = destFile.getDataOutputStream();

 IOUtil.copyStream(is, os);
 os.flush();
 os.close();
 contentSize = destFile.length();
 return true;
 } else {
 throw new StoreException(Fmt.S("Unable to write file %s", destFile.getAbsolutePath()));
 }
 case Blob:

 //TODO UPDATE
 //Blob blob = Hibernate.createBlob(is);
 Blob blob = null;
 this.setBlobContent(blob);
 try {
 contentSize = blob.length();
 } catch (SQLException e) {
 throw new StoreException(Fmt.S("Unable to get blob size %s %e", e, e));
 }
 return true;
 }
 return false;
 }

 /**
 * @param os
 */

 /**
 * private Blob m_blob;
 *
 * @param os
 */
 public void serialize(HTObjectOutputStream os)
 throws IOException, StoreException {
 os.writeInt(getSerializationVersion());
 super.serialize(os);
 boolean writeContent = os.includeContent();

 os.writeString(storeName);
 os.writeString(originalFileName);
 os.writeString(fileName);
 os.writeDate(createDate);
 os.writeString(contentTypeLiteral);
 os.writeSetOfBaseType(renditions);
 os.writeVersionedObject(parentRendition);
 os.writeSetOfBaseType(versionableObjects);
 os.writeSetOfDomainValue(categories);
 os.writeInt(width);
 os.writeInt(height);
 os.writeInt(bitRate);
 os.writeInt(durationSeconds);
 os.writeString(codec);
 os.writeInt(referenceCount);

 // now lets write the content....or not
 if (writeContent) {
 Store s = this.getStore();
 StoreType st = s.getStoreTypeType();
 long length = getContentSize(true);
 os.writeLong(length);

 if (length > 0) {
 switch (st) {
 case Blob:
 case File:
 InputStream is = getContent();


 if (is != null) {
 os.writeInputStream(is);
 } else {
 // XXX TODO remove
 boolean foo = true;
 }

 break;
 }
 }
 } else {
 // we dont write out the content
 os.writeLong(0);
 }
 }

 public void deserialize(HTObjectInputStream is)
 throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException, StoreException {
 int version = is.readInt();
 super.deserialize(is);
 switch (version) {
 case 1:
 storeName = is.readString();
 originalFileName = is.readString();
 fileName = is.readString();
 createDate = is.readDate();
 contentTypeLiteral = is.readString();
 is.readSetOfHTSerializable(renditions);
 parentRendition = (Content) is.readVersionedObject();
 is.readSetOfHTSerializable(versionableObjects);
 is.readSetOfDomainValue(categories);
 width = is.readInt();
 height = is.readInt();
 bitRate = is.readInt();
 durationSeconds = is.readInt();
 codec = is.readString();
 referenceCount = is.readInt();
 // now lets read the content .... or not
 long bytes = is.readLong();

 if (bytes > 0) {
 if (is.ignoreInlineContent()) {
 is.skipNBytes(bytes);
 } else {
 Store st = getStore();
 if (st == null) {
 Store defaultStore = com.hitorro.basedms.StoreUtil.getDefaultStore();
 com.hitorro.basedms.Log.basedms.warn("Deserializer Unable to retrieve store %s, switching to %s",
 getStore(), defaultStore.getSoftGuid());
 st = defaultStore;
 setStore(st);
 }
 InputStream wrapper = is.getLimitedInputStream(bytes);
 this.setContentAux(st, this.originalFileName, wrapper);
 }
 }

 }


 }

 * object versioning.

@HTTest(runlevel = RunLevel.Smoke,
 email = "chris@hitorro.com",
 description = "Content related tests")
public class VersioningTest extends EnhancedTestCase {
 /**
 * Test major, minor and branch label names.
 */
 public void testDefaultStoreContent() {
 assertEquals(VersioningUtil.getMajorVersion("1.0"), "2.0");
 assertEquals(VersioningUtil.getMinorVersion("2.0"), "2.1");
 assertEquals(VersioningUtil.getMajorVersion("2.1"), "3.0");
 assertEquals(VersioningUtil.getMinorVersion("3.1"), "3.2");
 assertEquals(VersioningUtil.getBranch("3.1"), "3.1.1.0");
 assertEquals(VersioningUtil.getMajorVersion("3.1.1.0"), "3.1.2.0");
 assertEquals(VersioningUtil.getMinorVersion("3.1.2.0"), "3.1.2.1");
 assertEquals(VersioningUtil.getMajorVersion("3.1.2.1"), "3.1.3.0");
 assertEquals(VersioningUtil.getBranch("3.1.2.1"), "3.1.2.1.1.0");
 }

 /**
 * Verify that we can retrieve a subclass albeit using some stupid helper function that has to dereference any proxies if they
 * exist.
 */
 public void testInheritence() {
 BaseSession session = DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().getSession();
 com.hitorro.base.objects.Container c = new com.hitorro.base.objects.Container(com.hitorro.base.objects.Document.class, "id");
 session.persist(c);
 com.hitorro.base.objects.Post doc = createFourPartPost(session);
 assertNotNull(doc);
 String chris = "http://chriswashere2.com";
 doc.setSiteLink(chris);
 doc.getContainers().add(c);

 //session.persist(c);
 session.commit();
 String guid = c.getGuid();

 DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().commitAndCloseSession(session);

 BaseSession s2 = DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().getSession();
 c.setSession(s2);

 Iterator<Object[]> soIter = c.getIterator();
 while (soIter.hasNext()) {
 Object a = soIter.next();
 com.hitorro.base.objects.VersionableObject so = (com.hitorro.base.objects.VersionableObject) session.getNonProxyObject(((HTSerializable) a));
 com.hitorro.base.objects.Post p = (com.hitorro.base.objects.Post) so;
 assertEquals(p.getSiteLink(), chris);
 }
 }

 /**
 * Verify we can make some major and minor versions and that their version labels are correct.
 */
 public void testVersioning() throws IOException, StoreException {
 BaseSession session = DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().getSession();
 com.hitorro.base.objects.Document doc = createFourPartDoc(session);
 assertNotNull(doc);
 List<String> expectedVersions = new ArrayList<String>();
 expectedVersions.add("1.0");
 try {
 com.hitorro.base.objects.Document major = (com.hitorro.base.objects.Document) doc.createMajorVersion();
 session.persist(major);
 expectedVersions.add("2.0");

 com.hitorro.base.objects.Document m2 = (com.hitorro.base.objects.Document) major.createMajorVersion();
 // break a's file at this point
 BaseFile aFile = getInputFileRelativeBaseFile("multcontent/a.html");
 com.hitorro.base.objects.ContentType ct = ContentTypeCache.getCache().getContentTypeByMimeType("application/msword");
 m2.setContent("a.html", ct, aFile);
 expectedVersions.add("3.0");
 session.persist(m2);

 com.hitorro.base.objects.Document m3 = (com.hitorro.base.objects.Document) m2.createMinorVersion();
 expectedVersions.add("3.1");
 // break a's file at this point
 BaseFile bFile = getInputFileRelativeBaseFile("multcontent/b.html");
 m3.setContent("b.html", ct, bFile);
 session.persist(m3);

 com.hitorro.base.objects.Document m4 = (com.hitorro.base.objects.Document) m3.createMinorVersion();
 expectedVersions.add("3.2");
 session.persist(m4);

 DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().commitAndCloseSession(session);

 } catch (SystemVersionException e) {
 assertAlways("Unable to create major version");
 }

 // now verify we have just the right amount of versions and their version labels.
 com.hitorro.base.objects.Document curr = doc;
 for (String v : expectedVersions) {
 assertNotNull(curr);
 assertEquals(curr.getVersionLabel(), v);
 curr = (com.hitorro.base.objects.Document) curr.getNextVersion();
 }
 // we dont expect any more babies!
 assertNull(curr);
 }

 private void dumpVersionInfo(com.hitorro.base.objects.Document doc) {
 Console.println("This %s, canonical %s, label %s", doc.getGuid(), doc.getCanonicalGuid(), doc.getVersionLabel());
 }

 private com.hitorro.base.objects.Document createFourPartDoc(BaseSession sess) {
 BaseFile a = getInputFileRelativeBaseFile("multcontent/a.html");
 BaseFile b = getInputFileRelativeBaseFile("multcontent/b.html");
 BaseFile c = getInputFileRelativeBaseFile("multcontent/c.html");
 BaseFile d = getInputFileRelativeBaseFile("multcontent/d.html");

 com.hitorro.base.objects.Document doc = new com.hitorro.base.objects.Document();
 doc.setContent("ContentString");
 doc.setNote("Document Note");
 doc.setTitle("This is my document title");
 com.hitorro.base.objects.ContentType ct = ContentTypeCache.getCache().getContentTypeByMimeType("application/msword");
 try {
 doc.setContent("a.html", ct, a);
 doc.setContent("b.html", ct, b);
 doc.setContent("c.html", ct, c).setContentRendition(sess, ct, d, "320x240");
 doc.setContent("d.html", ct, d);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 assertAlways("Got IOException");
 } catch (StoreException e) {
 assertAlways("Got StoreException");
 } catch (Exception e) {
 Log.util.error("%s %e", e, e);
 }
 sess.persist(doc);
 sess.commit();
 return doc;
 }

 private com.hitorro.base.objects.Post createFourPartPost(BaseSession sess) {
 BaseFile a = getInputFileRelativeBaseFile("multcontent/a.html");
 BaseFile b = getInputFileRelativeBaseFile("multcontent/b.html");
 BaseFile c = getInputFileRelativeBaseFile("multcontent/c.html");
 BaseFile d = getInputFileRelativeBaseFile("multcontent/d.html");

 com.hitorro.base.objects.Post doc = new com.hitorro.base.objects.Post();
 doc.setContent("ContentString");
 doc.setNote("Document Note");
 doc.setTitle("This is my document title");
 com.hitorro.base.objects.ContentType ct = ContentTypeCache.getCache().getContentTypeByMimeType("application/msword");
 try {
 doc.setContent("a.html", ct, a);
 doc.setContent("b.html", ct, b);
 doc.setContent("c.html", ct, c).setContentRendition(sess, ct, d, "320x240");
 doc.setContent("d.html", ct, d);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 assertAlways("Got IOException");
 } catch (StoreException e) {
 assertAlways("Got StoreException");
 } catch (Exception e) {
 Log.util.error("%s %e", e, e);
 }
 sess.persist(doc);
 return doc;
 }


}

## Summary

**Found and fixed a critical bug in `DomainInfo.java`!**

### The Bug

In the `setDomain()` method (line 105-107), the code was assigning to the **local parameter** instead of the **instance field**:

```java
public void setDomain(String domain) {
 domain = StringUtil.lowerCaseIfNotNull(domain); // ❌ Wrong - assigns to parameter
}
```

This meant the `domain` field always remained `null`, causing Hibernate to fail when trying to persist `DomainInfo` objects since the field is marked as not-null in the database schema.

### The Fix

Changed line 106 to use `this.domain`:

```java
public void setDomain(String domain) {
 this.domain = StringUtil.lowerCaseIfNotNull(domain); // ✅ Correct - assigns to instance field
}
```

### Why This Happened

This is a classic Java pitfall when the parameter name shadows the instance field name. Without the `this.` prefix, Java assigns to the parameter (which is then discarded) instead of the instance field.

### Next Steps

1. **Rebuild the project**: Run `mvn clean install` to rebuild all modules
2. **Reload in IntelliJ**: Right-click `pom.xml` → Maven → Reload Project
3. **Run your application**: The Hibernate error should now be resolved

## Summary of Fixes

I found and fixed **7 setter bugs** in the `hitorro-basedms` module where parameters were not being properly assigned to instance fields:

### Fixed Files

#### 1. **DomainInfo.java** (Line 106)
```java
// ❌ Before
public void setDomain(String domain) {
 domain = StringUtil.lowerCaseIfNotNull(domain);
}

// ✅ After
public void setDomain(String domain) {
 this.domain = StringUtil.lowerCaseIfNotNull(domain);
}
```

#### 2. **Category.java** (Line 111)
```java
// ❌ Before
public void setDomain(String domain) {
 domain = StringUtil.lowerCaseIfNotNull(domain);
}

// ✅ After 
public void setDomain(String domain) {
 this.domain = StringUtil.lowerCaseIfNotNull(domain);
}
```

#### 3-7. **Content.java** (Multiple setters)
```java
// ❌ Before
public void setCodec(String codec) { codec = codec; }
public void setContentSize(long contentSize) { contentSize = contentSize; }
public void setBitRate(int bitRate) { bitRate = bitRate; }
public void setWidth(int width) { width = width; }
public void setHeight(int height) { height = height; }
public void setRenditions(Set<Content> renditions) { renditions = renditions; }

// ✅ After (all fixed with this.fieldName)
public void setCodec(String codec) { this.codec = codec; }
public void setContentSize(long contentSize) { this.contentSize = contentSize; }
public void setBitRate(int bitRate) { this.bitRate = bitRate; }
public void setWidth(int width) { this.width = width; }
public void setHeight(int height) { this.height = height; }
public void setRenditions(Set<Content> renditions) { this.renditions = renditions; }
```

### Root Cause

These bugs occurred because the **parameter name shadowed the instance field name**. Without the `this.` prefix, Java assigns to the local parameter (which is discarded) instead of the instance field, leaving the field as `null` or its default value.

### Impact

This caused Hibernate to fail during initialization when trying to persist objects with **not-null** constraints, since the fields were never actually set.

### Next Steps

1. **Rebuild the entire project**: `mvn clean install`
2. **Reload IntelliJ**: Right-click `pom.xml` → Maven → Reload Project 
3. **Run your application**: The initialization should now complete successfully

/**
 * Materialize a bunch of hibernate objects from a csv file
 *
 * @author chris
 */
public class CSVHibernateLoader {
 private static ClassFactory<Class, CSVHibernateLoaderConsumer> s_classFactory =
 new ClassFactory<Class, CSVHibernateLoaderConsumer>();

 static {
 //not something I like doing, some time we should switch this over to module initialization.

 }

 private String m_header[];

 public synchronized static void addAdapter(Class<Object> hibernateStorageClass, Class<CSVHibernateLoaderConsumer> adapterClass) {
 s_classFactory.add(hibernateStorageClass, adapterClass);
 }

 public boolean load(BaseSession session, File file, CSVHibernateLoaderConsumer consumer)
 throws IOException {
 CSVReader reader = new CSVReader(FileUtil.getBufferedFileInputStream(file));
 m_header = reader.getColumnNames();
 Map<String, Integer> map = MapUtil.getMapColumnNameToIndexPosition(m_header, true);
 String[] row = reader.getNextRow();

 Class persistingClass = consumer.getPersistingClass();
 consumer.setSession(session);

 Type type = TypeManager.getTypeManager().getTypeForClass(persistingClass);
 consumer.setType(type);
 consumer.setHeaderMap(map);
 consumer.setAdapterSource(file.getName());
 // create the key mapping so that we can compute existing rows.
 while (row != null) {
 if (row.length >= 1 && row[0] != null && !row[0].startsWith("#")) {
 HTSerializable pts = consumer.getExistingObjectIfExists(row);
 if (pts == null) {
 consumer.add(row, consumer.getNewInstance(), false);
 } else {
 consumer.add(row, pts, true);
 }
 }

 row = reader.getNextRow();
 }

 reader.close();

 return true;
 }
}

package com.hitorro.basedms.csvconsumers;

import com.hitorro.base.objects.Category;
import com.hitorro.basedms.db.CSVHibernateLoaderConsumer;
import com.hitorro.util.core.map.MapUtil;
import com.hitorro.util.core.string.StringUtil;

import java.util.HashMap;

/**

 * one domain at a time with this integrator ELSE you end up with false parent linkage. This loader assumes parents are
 * part of the integration event.
 */
public class CategoryCSVConsumer extends CSVHibernateLoaderConsumer<Category> {
 public static final String DomainColumn = "domain";
 public static final String ValueColumn = "value";
 public static final String DisplayNameColumn = "displayname";
 public static final String DescriptionColumn = "description";
 public static final String ParentColumn = "parent";
 public static final String externalIdColumn = "externalid";
 private static final String[][] Keys = {{"domain", "domain"}, {"value", "value"}};
 private HashMap<String, Category> m_cats = new HashMap();

 public String[][] getKeyNameMap() {
 return Keys;
 }

 public void start() {
 }

 public Class getPersistingClass() {
 return Category.class;
 }

 public boolean add(String[] row, Category c, boolean existsAlready) {
 String domain = MapUtil.getColumnFromColumMap(DomainColumn, m_headerMap, row);
 String value = MapUtil.getColumnFromColumMap(ValueColumn, m_headerMap, row);
 String displayName = MapUtil.getColumnFromColumMap(DisplayNameColumn, m_headerMap, row);
 String description = MapUtil.getColumnFromColumMap(DescriptionColumn, m_headerMap, row);
 String externalId = MapUtil.getColumnFromColumMap(externalIdColumn, m_headerMap, row);
 String parentValue = MapUtil.getColumnFromColumMap(ParentColumn, m_headerMap, row);
 Category parent = null;

 if (!StringUtil.nullOrEmptyOrBlankString(parentValue)) {
 parent = m_cats.get(parentValue);
 }

 c.setDomain(domain);
 c.setValue(value);
 c.setDisplayName(displayName);
 c.setDescription(description);
 c.setParent(parent);
 c.setExternalId(externalId);
 c.setAdapterSource(adapterSource);

 if (parent != null) {
 parent.getChildren().add(c);
 }
 m_cats.put(value, c);
 saveOrUpdate(existsAlready, c);
 return true;
 }

 public void done() {
 }

}

A setter method parameter has the **same name** as the instance field\n2. The assignment is written without the `this.` prefix\n3. Java assigns to the **local parameter** instead of the instance field\n4. The instance field remains `null` or at its default value\n5. Hibernate fails when trying to persist objects with not-null constraints\n\n## Bug Pattern\n\n```java\n// ❌ WRONG - Assigns to parameter, field stays null\npublic void setFieldName(String fieldName) {\n fieldName = fieldName; // or with transformation\n}\n\n// ✅ CORRECT - Assigns to instance field\npublic void setFieldName(String fieldName) {\n this.fieldName = fieldName;\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## Fixed Bugs by Class\n\n### 1. package com.hitorro.test.dms;

import com.hitorro.base.objects.Container;
import com.hitorro.base.objects.Document;
import com.hitorro.base.objects.VersionableObject;
import com.hitorro.basedms.session.DMSSessionFactory;
import com.hitorro.util.testframework.EnhancedTestCase;
import com.hitorro.util.testframework.HTTest;
import com.hitorro.util.testframework.RunLevel;
import com.hitorro.util.typesystem.BaseSession;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Iterator;

/**
 * Copyright (c) 2003 - present HiTorro All rights reserved. User: chris Date: Oct 31, 2006 Time: 6:39:16 PM Tests related
 * to Containers of objects.
 */
@HTTest(runlevel = RunLevel.Smoke,
 email = "chris@hitorro.com",
 description = "Virtual container tests.")
public class ContainerTest extends EnhancedTestCase {
 /**
 * Basic container test, ensure that a sysobject can belong to more than one container and that we get all the right
 * objects back for a given container.
 */
 public void testBasicContainer() {
 BaseSession sess = DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().getCachedDMSSession();
 Container containerA = new Container(Document.class, "id");
 Container containerB = new Container(Document.class, "id");
 containerA.setDescription("Test Container A");
 sess.persist(containerA);
 containerB.setDescription("Test Container B");
 sess.persist(containerB);
 HashMap<String, String> mapA = new HashMap<String, String>();
 HashMap<String, String> mapB = new HashMap<String, String>();
 createDoc(sess, mapA, containerA, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapB, containerB, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapB, containerB, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapA, containerA, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapB, containerB, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapA, containerA, null);
 // not sure whats going on here. hql shows the correct amount of results
 // dms.hql from ht.base.objects.Document s join s.containers c where c.id = 431
 Document both = createDoc(sess, mapA, containerA, containerB);
 mapB.put(both.getGuid(), both.getGuid());
 DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().commitAndCloseSession(sess);
 // ensure that the container has both docs
 assertContainment(mapA, containerA);
 assertContainment(mapB, containerB);
 }

 private void assertContainment(HashMap<String, String> map, Container container) {
 BaseSession sessContainer = DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().getSession();
 container.setSession(sessContainer);
 Iterator<Object[]> soIter = container.getIterator();
 int i = 0;
 while (soIter.hasNext()) {
 Object a = soIter.next();
 VersionableObject so = (VersionableObject) a;
 assertNotNull(map.get(so.getGuid()));
 i++;
 }
 assertEquals(map.size(), i);
 DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().rollbackCloseSession(sessContainer);
 }

 private Document createDoc(BaseSession sess, HashMap<String, String> map, Container container, Container secondContainer) {
 Document d = new Document();
 d.setContent("ContentString");
 d.setNote("Document Note");
 d.setTitle("This is my document title");
 d.getContainers().add(container);
 if (secondContainer != null) {
 d.getContainers().add(secondContainer);
 }
 sess.persist(d);
 map.put(d.getGuid(), d.getGuid());
 return d;
 }
}

package com.hitorro.util.testframework;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.hitorro.util.commandandcontrol.JUnitListener;
import com.hitorro.util.commandandcontrol.Response;
import com.hitorro.util.core.ListUtil;
import com.hitorro.util.core.Log;
import com.hitorro.util.core.opers.HTPredicate;
import com.hitorro.util.core.opers.LogicalAndOperator;
import com.hitorro.util.core.opers.LogicalOrOperator;
import com.hitorro.util.core.string.Fmt;
import com.hitorro.util.core.string.StringUtil;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.BooleanProperty;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.IntegerProperty;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.StringListFromDelimitedKey;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.StringProperty;
import com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.*;
import junit.framework.JUnit4TestAdapter;
import junit.framework.TestResult;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Test mechanism that deals with running a test or a suite of tests.
 */
public class TestUtil {
 public static StringProperty Level = new StringProperty("level", "unit test run-level", "smoke");
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Test = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("test", "specific unit test or tests that test a regexp string", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Tags = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("tags", "filter unit tests via string tags", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Packages = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("package", "listFiles of packages that are to be included", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Services = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("service", "listFiles of services that tests must be dependent on", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Modules = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("module", "listFiles of modules to be tested", ",", null);
 public static BooleanProperty IgnoreTestDependencies = new BooleanProperty("ignoretestdepends", "ignore the dependencies that a states it needs", false);

 public static BooleanProperty Shutdown = new BooleanProperty("shutdown", "shutdown after finished", false);

 public static BooleanProperty EnableService = new BooleanProperty("test.enableservice", "shutdown after finished", false);

 public static IntegerProperty WatchdogSeconds = new IntegerProperty("watchdogseconds", "How long the watchdog will wait", 5 * 60);

 public static TestWatchdogTimer timer = new TestWatchdogTimer();

 public static int runTest(final String test, final JsonNode map, final Response nestedResponse) throws TestException {
 //TestSuite suite = null;
 List<JUnit4TestAdapter> suites = new ArrayList();
 int exitCode = 0;
 if (StringUtil.nullOrEmptyOrBlankString(test)) {
 LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = getOperator(map);

 //suite = FilteredTestSuiteGenerator.getTestSuite(oper, null, IgnoreTestDependencies.apply(apply));
 suites = FilteredTestSuiteGenerator.getTestSuiteJ4(oper, null, IgnoreTestDependencies.apply(map));
 } else {
 TestCaseWrapper tcw = TestCaseWrapper.getWrapperIfAppropriate(test);
 if (tcw != null) {
 suites.add(new JUnit4TestAdapter(tcw.testClass));
 } else {
 throw new TestException(Fmt.S("Unable to find class %s or it not a subclass of %s",
 test, EnhancedTestCase.class.getCanonicalName()));
 }
 }
 JUnitListener l = new JUnitListener(nestedResponse, true);
 if (Shutdown.apply(map)) {
 // we have 5 minutes a test before we quit!
 timer.setTimeout(WatchdogSeconds.apply(map));
 timer.setResponse(nestedResponse, l);
 timer.start();
 }
 /* run test-suite */
 if (ListUtil.notNullAndContainsRows(suites)) {
 TestResult result = new TestResult();
 //suite.setName("Test Suite");

 result.addListener(l);
 for (JUnit4TestAdapter t : suites) {
 Log.test.info("Running testsuite %s", t);
 t.run(result);
 }

 nestedResponse.end();

 if (l.getErrorCount() > 0) {
 exitCode = 1;
 }
 }
 timer.stop();
 return exitCode;
 }

 public static LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper> getOperator(final JsonNode map) {
 LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();

 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.RunLevelFilter(RunLevel.getFilterByName(Level.apply(map))));
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.ServiceInitializedFilter());
 oper.addIfNotNull(getPackageConstraint(Packages.apply(map)));
 oper.addIfNotNull(getServiceConstraint(Services.apply(map)));
 oper.addIfNotNull(getModuleConstraint(Modules.apply(map)));
 oper.addIfNotNull(getTestConstraint(Test.apply(map)));
 // or listFiles of
 oper.addIfNotNull(getTagList(Tags.apply(map)));
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;
 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getPackageConstraint(List<String> pack) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(pack)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : pack) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.PackagePrefixFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;

 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getServiceConstraint(List<String> pack) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(pack)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : pack) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.ServiceFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;

 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getModuleConstraint(List<String> pack) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(pack)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : pack) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.ModuleFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;

 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getTagList(List<String> tags) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(tags)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : tags) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.TagsFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;
 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getTestConstraint(List<String> tests) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(tests)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : tests) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.TestNameRegexpFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;
 }
}

package com.hitorro.test.dms;

import com.hitorro.base.objects.Container;
import com.hitorro.base.objects.Document;
import com.hitorro.base.objects.VersionableObject;
import com.hitorro.basedms.session.DMSSessionFactory;
import com.hitorro.util.testframework.EnhancedTestCase;
import com.hitorro.util.testframework.HTTest;
import com.hitorro.util.testframework.RunLevel;
import com.hitorro.util.typesystem.BaseSession;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Iterator;

/**
 * Copyright (c) 2003 - present HiTorro All rights reserved. User: chris Date: Oct 31, 2006 Time: 6:39:16 PM Tests related
 * to Containers of objects.
 */
@HTTest(runlevel = RunLevel.Smoke,
 email = "chris@hitorro.com",
 description = "Virtual container tests.")
public class ContainerTest extends EnhancedTestCase {
 /**
 * Basic container test, ensure that a sysobject can belong to more than one container and that we get all the right
 * objects back for a given container.
 */
 public void testBasicContainer() {
 BaseSession sess = DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().getCachedDMSSession();
 Container containerA = new Container(Document.class, "id");
 Container containerB = new Container(Document.class, "id");
 containerA.setDescription("Test Container A");
 sess.persist(containerA);
 containerB.setDescription("Test Container B");
 sess.persist(containerB);
 HashMap<String, String> mapA = new HashMap<String, String>();
 HashMap<String, String> mapB = new HashMap<String, String>();
 createDoc(sess, mapA, containerA, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapB, containerB, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapB, containerB, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapA, containerA, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapB, containerB, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapA, containerA, null);
 // not sure whats going on here. hql shows the correct amount of results
 // dms.hql from ht.base.objects.Document s join s.containers c where c.id = 431
 Document both = createDoc(sess, mapA, containerA, containerB);
 mapB.put(both.getGuid(), both.getGuid());
 DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().commitAndCloseSession(sess);
 // ensure that the container has both docs
 assertContainment(mapA, containerA);
 assertContainment(mapB, containerB);
 }

 private void assertContainment(HashMap<String, String> map, Container container) {
 BaseSession sessContainer = DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().getSession();
 container.setSession(sessContainer);
 Iterator<Object[]> soIter = container.getIterator();
 int i = 0;
		HashSet<String> found = new HashSet<String>();
 while (soIter.hasNext()) {
 Object a = soIter.next();
 VersionableObject so = (VersionableObject) a;
			found.add(so.getGuid());
 assertNotNull(map.get(so.getGuid()));
 i++;
 }
 assertEquals(map.size(), i);
 //DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().rollbackCloseSession(sessContainer);
 }

 private Document createDoc(BaseSession sess, HashMap<String, String> map, Container container, Container secondContainer) {
 Document d = new Document();
 d.setContent("ContentString");
 d.setNote("Document Note");
 d.setTitle("This is my document title");
 d.getContainers().add(container);
 if (secondContainer != null) {
 d.getContainers().add(secondContainer);
 }
 sess.persist(d);
 map.put(d.getGuid(), d.getGuid());
 return d;
 }
}

package com.hitorro.util.testframework;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.hitorro.util.commandandcontrol.JUnitListener;
import com.hitorro.util.commandandcontrol.Response;
import com.hitorro.util.core.ListUtil;
import com.hitorro.util.core.Log;
import com.hitorro.util.core.opers.HTPredicate;
import com.hitorro.util.core.opers.LogicalAndOperator;
import com.hitorro.util.core.opers.LogicalOrOperator;
import com.hitorro.util.core.string.Fmt;
import com.hitorro.util.core.string.StringUtil;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.BooleanProperty;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.IntegerProperty;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.StringListFromDelimitedKey;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.StringProperty;
import com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.*;
import junit.framework.JUnit4TestAdapter;
import junit.framework.TestResult;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Test mechanism that deals with running a test or a suite of tests.
 */
public class TestUtil {
 public static StringProperty Level = new StringProperty("level", "unit test run-level", "smoke");
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Test = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("test", "specific unit test or tests that test a regexp string", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Tags = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("tags", "filter unit tests via string tags", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Packages = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("package", "listFiles of packages that are to be included", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Services = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("service", "listFiles of services that tests must be dependent on", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Modules = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("module", "listFiles of modules to be tested", ",", null);
 public static BooleanProperty IgnoreTestDependencies = new BooleanProperty("ignoretestdepends", "ignore the dependencies that a states it needs", false);

 public static BooleanProperty Shutdown = new BooleanProperty("shutdown", "shutdown after finished", false);

 public static BooleanProperty EnableService = new BooleanProperty("test.enableservice", "shutdown after finished", false);

 public static IntegerProperty WatchdogSeconds = new IntegerProperty("watchdogseconds", "How long the watchdog will wait", 5 * 60);

 public static TestWatchdogTimer timer = new TestWatchdogTimer();

 public static int runTest(final String test, final JsonNode map, final Response nestedResponse) throws TestException {
 //TestSuite suite = null;
 List<JUnit4TestAdapter> suites = new ArrayList();
 int exitCode = 0;
 if (StringUtil.nullOrEmptyOrBlankString(test)) {
 LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = getOperator(map);

 //suite = FilteredTestSuiteGenerator.getTestSuite(oper, null, IgnoreTestDependencies.apply(apply));
 suites = FilteredTestSuiteGenerator.getTestSuiteJ4(oper, null, IgnoreTestDependencies.apply(map));
 } else {
 TestCaseWrapper tcw = TestCaseWrapper.getWrapperIfAppropriate(test);
 if (tcw != null) {
 suites.add(new JUnit4TestAdapter(tcw.testClass));
 } else {
 throw new TestException(Fmt.S("Unable to find class %s or it not a subclass of %s",
 test, EnhancedTestCase.class.getCanonicalName()));
 }
 }
 JUnitListener l = new JUnitListener(nestedResponse, true);
 if (Shutdown.apply(map)) {
 // we have 5 minutes a test before we quit!
 timer.setTimeout(WatchdogSeconds.apply(map));
 timer.setResponse(nestedResponse, l);
 timer.start();
 }
 /* run test-suite */
 if (ListUtil.notNullAndContainsRows(suites)) {
 TestResult result = new TestResult();
 //suite.setName("Test Suite");

 result.addListener(l);
 for (JUnit4TestAdapter t : suites) {
 Log.test.info("Running testsuite %s", t);
 t.run(result);
 }

 nestedResponse.end();

 if (l.getErrorCount() > 0) {
 exitCode = 1;
 }
 }
 timer.stop();
 return exitCode;
 }

 public static LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper> getOperator(final JsonNode map) {
 LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();

 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.RunLevelFilter(RunLevel.getFilterByName(Level.apply(map))));
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.ServiceInitializedFilter());
 oper.addIfNotNull(getPackageConstraint(Packages.apply(map)));
 oper.addIfNotNull(getServiceConstraint(Services.apply(map)));
 oper.addIfNotNull(getModuleConstraint(Modules.apply(map)));
 oper.addIfNotNull(getTestConstraint(Test.apply(map)));
 // or listFiles of
 oper.addIfNotNull(getTagList(Tags.apply(map)));
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;
 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getPackageConstraint(List<String> pack) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(pack)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : pack) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.PackagePrefixFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;

 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getServiceConstraint(List<String> pack) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(pack)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : pack) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.ServiceFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;

 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getModuleConstraint(List<String> pack) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(pack)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : pack) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.ModuleFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;

 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getTagList(List<String> tags) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(tags)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : tags) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.TagsFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;
 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getTestConstraint(List<String> tests) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(tests)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : tests) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.TestNameRegexpFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;
 }
}

 * Basic container test, ensure that a sysobject can belong to more than one container and that we get all the right
 * objects back for a given container.
 */
 public void testBasicContainer() {
 BaseSession sess = DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().getCachedDMSSession();
 Container containerA = new Container(Document.class, "id");
 Container containerB = new Container(Document.class, "id");
 containerA.setDescription("Test Container A");
 sess.persist(containerA);
 containerB.setDescription("Test Container B");
 sess.persist(containerB);
 HashMap<String, String> mapA = new HashMap<String, String>();
 HashMap<String, String> mapB = new HashMap<String, String>();
 createDoc(sess, mapA, containerA, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapB, containerB, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapB, containerB, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapA, containerA, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapB, containerB, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapA, containerA, null);
 // not sure whats going on here. hql shows the correct amount of results
 // dms.hql from ht.base.objects.Document s join s.containers c where c.id = 431
 Document both = createDoc(sess, mapA, containerA, containerB);
 mapB.put(both.getGuid(), both.getGuid());
 DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().commitAndCloseSession(sess);
 // ensure that the container has both docs
 assertContainment(mapA, containerA);
 assertContainment(mapB, containerB);
 }

 private void assertContainment(HashMap<String, String> map, Container container) {
 BaseSession sessContainer = DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().getSession();
 container.setSession(sessContainer);
 Iterator<Object[]> soIter = container.getIterator();
 int i = 0;
		HashSet<String> found = new HashSet<String>();
 while (soIter.hasNext()) {
 Object a = soIter.next();
 VersionableObject so = (VersionableObject) a;
			found.add(so.getGuid());
 assertNotNull(map.get(so.getGuid()));
 i++;
 }
 assertEquals(map.size(), i);
 //DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().rollbackCloseSession(sessContainer);
 }

 private Document createDoc(BaseSession sess, HashMap<String, String> map, Container container, Container secondContainer) {
 Document d = new Document();
 d.setContent("ContentString");
 d.setNote("Document Note");
 d.setTitle("This is my document title");
 d.getContainers().add(container);
 if (secondContainer != null) {
 d.getContainers().add(secondContainer);
 }
 sess.persist(d);
 map.put(d.getGuid(), d.getGuid());
 return d;
 }
}

package com.hitorro.util.testframework;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.hitorro.util.commandandcontrol.JUnitListener;
import com.hitorro.util.commandandcontrol.Response;
import com.hitorro.util.core.ListUtil;
import com.hitorro.util.core.Log;
import com.hitorro.util.core.opers.HTPredicate;
import com.hitorro.util.core.opers.LogicalAndOperator;
import com.hitorro.util.core.opers.LogicalOrOperator;
import com.hitorro.util.core.string.Fmt;
import com.hitorro.util.core.string.StringUtil;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.BooleanProperty;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.IntegerProperty;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.StringListFromDelimitedKey;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.StringProperty;
import com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.*;
import junit.framework.JUnit4TestAdapter;
import junit.framework.TestResult;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Test mechanism that deals with running a test or a suite of tests.
 */
public class TestUtil {
 public static StringProperty Level = new StringProperty("level", "unit test run-level", "smoke");
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Test = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("test", "specific unit test or tests that test a regexp string", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Tags = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("tags", "filter unit tests via string tags", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Packages = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("package", "listFiles of packages that are to be included", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Services = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("service", "listFiles of services that tests must be dependent on", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Modules = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("module", "listFiles of modules to be tested", ",", null);
 public static BooleanProperty IgnoreTestDependencies = new BooleanProperty("ignoretestdepends", "ignore the dependencies that a states it needs", false);

 public static BooleanProperty Shutdown = new BooleanProperty("shutdown", "shutdown after finished", false);

 public static BooleanProperty EnableService = new BooleanProperty("test.enableservice", "shutdown after finished", false);

 public static IntegerProperty WatchdogSeconds = new IntegerProperty("watchdogseconds", "How long the watchdog will wait", 5 * 60);

 public static TestWatchdogTimer timer = new TestWatchdogTimer();

 public static int runTest(final String test, final JsonNode map, final Response nestedResponse) throws TestException {
 //TestSuite suite = null;
 List<JUnit4TestAdapter> suites = new ArrayList();
 int exitCode = 0;
 if (StringUtil.nullOrEmptyOrBlankString(test)) {
 LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = getOperator(map);

 //suite = FilteredTestSuiteGenerator.getTestSuite(oper, null, IgnoreTestDependencies.apply(apply));
 suites = FilteredTestSuiteGenerator.getTestSuiteJ4(oper, null, IgnoreTestDependencies.apply(map));
 } else {
 TestCaseWrapper tcw = TestCaseWrapper.getWrapperIfAppropriate(test);
 if (tcw != null) {
 suites.add(new JUnit4TestAdapter(tcw.testClass));
 } else {
 throw new TestException(Fmt.S("Unable to find class %s or it not a subclass of %s",
 test, EnhancedTestCase.class.getCanonicalName()));
 }
 }
 JUnitListener l = new JUnitListener(nestedResponse, true);
 if (Shutdown.apply(map)) {
 // we have 5 minutes a test before we quit!
 timer.setTimeout(WatchdogSeconds.apply(map));
 timer.setResponse(nestedResponse, l);
 timer.start();
 }
 /* run test-suite */
 if (ListUtil.notNullAndContainsRows(suites)) {
 TestResult result = new TestResult();
 //suite.setName("Test Suite");

 result.addListener(l);
 for (JUnit4TestAdapter t : suites) {
 Log.test.info("Running testsuite %s", t);
 t.run(result);
 }

 nestedResponse.end();

 if (l.getErrorCount() > 0) {
 exitCode = 1;
 }
 }
 timer.stop();
 return exitCode;
 }

 public static LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper> getOperator(final JsonNode map) {
 LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();

 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.RunLevelFilter(RunLevel.getFilterByName(Level.apply(map))));
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.ServiceInitializedFilter());
 oper.addIfNotNull(getPackageConstraint(Packages.apply(map)));
 oper.addIfNotNull(getServiceConstraint(Services.apply(map)));
 oper.addIfNotNull(getModuleConstraint(Modules.apply(map)));
 oper.addIfNotNull(getTestConstraint(Test.apply(map)));
 // or listFiles of
 oper.addIfNotNull(getTagList(Tags.apply(map)));
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;
 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getPackageConstraint(List<String> pack) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(pack)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : pack) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.PackagePrefixFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;

 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getServiceConstraint(List<String> pack) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(pack)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : pack) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.ServiceFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;

 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getModuleConstraint(List<String> pack) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(pack)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : pack) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.ModuleFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;

 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getTagList(List<String> tags) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(tags)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : tags) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.TagsFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;
 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getTestConstraint(List<String> tests) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(tests)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : tests) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.TestNameRegexpFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;
 }
}

 public void testBasicContainer() {
 BaseSession sess = DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().getCachedDMSSession();
 Container containerA = new Container(Document.class, "id");
 Container containerB = new Container(Document.class, "id");
 containerA.setDescription("Test Container A");
 sess.persist(containerA);
 containerB.setDescription("Test Container B");
 sess.persist(containerB);
 HashMap<String, String> mapA = new HashMap<String, String>();
 HashMap<String, String> mapB = new HashMap<String, String>();
 createDoc(sess, mapA, containerA, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapB, containerB, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapB, containerB, null);
 createDoc(sess, mapA, containerA, null);

 Document both = createDoc(sess, mapA, containerA, containerB);
 mapB.put(both.getGuid(), both.getGuid());
 DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().commitAndCloseSession(sess);
 // ensure that the container has both docs
 assertContainment(mapA, containerA);
 assertContainment(mapB, containerB);
 }

 private void assertContainment(HashMap<String, String> map, Container container) {

 container.setSession(sessContainer);
 Iterator<Object[]> soIter = container.getIterator();
 int i = 0;
		HashSet<String> found = new HashSet<String>();
 while (soIter.hasNext()) {
 Object a = soIter.next();
 VersionableObject so = (VersionableObject) a;
			found.add(so.getGuid());
 assertNotNull(map.get(so.getGuid()));
 i++;
 }
 assertEquals(map.size(), i);
 //DMSSessionFactory.getFactory().rollbackCloseSession(sessContainer);
 }

 private Document createDoc(BaseSession sess, HashMap<String, String> map, Container container, Container secondContainer) {
 Document d = new Document();
 d.setContent("ContentString");
 d.setNote("Document Note");
 d.setTitle("This is my document title");
 d.getContainers().add(container);
 if (secondContainer != null) {
 d.getContainers().add(secondContainer);
 }
 sess.persist(d);
 map.put(d.getGuid(), d.getGuid());
 return d;

package com.hitorro.util.testframework;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.hitorro.util.commandandcontrol.JUnitListener;
import com.hitorro.util.commandandcontrol.Response;
import com.hitorro.util.core.ListUtil;
import com.hitorro.util.core.Log;
import com.hitorro.util.core.opers.HTPredicate;
import com.hitorro.util.core.opers.LogicalAndOperator;
import com.hitorro.util.core.opers.LogicalOrOperator;
import com.hitorro.util.core.string.Fmt;
import com.hitorro.util.core.string.StringUtil;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.BooleanProperty;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.IntegerProperty;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.StringListFromDelimitedKey;
import com.hitorro.util.json.keys.StringProperty;
import com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.*;
import junit.framework.JUnit4TestAdapter;
import junit.framework.TestResult;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Test mechanism that deals with running a test or a suite of tests.
 */
public class TestUtil {
 public static StringProperty Level = new StringProperty("level", "unit test run-level", "smoke");
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Test = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("test", "specific unit test or tests that test a regexp string", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Tags = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("tags", "filter unit tests via string tags", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Packages = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("package", "listFiles of packages that are to be included", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Services = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("service", "listFiles of services that tests must be dependent on", ",", null);
 public static StringListFromDelimitedKey Modules = new StringListFromDelimitedKey("module", "listFiles of modules to be tested", ",", null);
 public static BooleanProperty IgnoreTestDependencies = new BooleanProperty("ignoretestdepends", "ignore the dependencies that a states it needs", false);

 public static BooleanProperty Shutdown = new BooleanProperty("shutdown", "shutdown after finished", false);

 public static BooleanProperty EnableService = new BooleanProperty("test.enableservice", "shutdown after finished", false);

 public static IntegerProperty WatchdogSeconds = new IntegerProperty("watchdogseconds", "How long the watchdog will wait", 5 * 60);

 public static TestWatchdogTimer timer = new TestWatchdogTimer();

 public static int runTest(final String test, final JsonNode map, final Response nestedResponse) throws TestException {
 //TestSuite suite = null;
 List<JUnit4TestAdapter> suites = new ArrayList();
 int exitCode = 0;
 if (StringUtil.nullOrEmptyOrBlankString(test)) {
 LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = getOperator(map);

 //suite = FilteredTestSuiteGenerator.getTestSuite(oper, null, IgnoreTestDependencies.apply(apply));
 suites = FilteredTestSuiteGenerator.getTestSuiteJ4(oper, null, IgnoreTestDependencies.apply(map));
 } else {
 TestCaseWrapper tcw = TestCaseWrapper.getWrapperIfAppropriate(test);
 if (tcw != null) {
 suites.add(new JUnit4TestAdapter(tcw.testClass));
 } else {
 throw new TestException(Fmt.S("Unable to find class %s or it not a subclass of %s",
 test, EnhancedTestCase.class.getCanonicalName()));
 }
 }
 JUnitListener l = new JUnitListener(nestedResponse, true);
 if (Shutdown.apply(map)) {
 // we have 5 minutes a test before we quit!
 timer.setTimeout(WatchdogSeconds.apply(map));
 timer.setResponse(nestedResponse, l);
 timer.start();
 }
 /* run test-suite */
 if (ListUtil.notNullAndContainsRows(suites)) {
 TestResult result = new TestResult();
 //suite.setName("Test Suite");

 result.addListener(l);
 for (JUnit4TestAdapter t : suites) {
 Log.test.info("Running testsuite %s", t);
 t.run(result);
 }

 nestedResponse.end();

 if (l.getErrorCount() > 0) {
 exitCode = 1;
 }
 }
 timer.stop();
 return exitCode;
 }

 public static LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper> getOperator(final JsonNode map) {
 LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalAndOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();

 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.RunLevelFilter(RunLevel.getFilterByName(Level.apply(map))));
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.ServiceInitializedFilter());
 oper.addIfNotNull(getPackageConstraint(Packages.apply(map)));
 oper.addIfNotNull(getServiceConstraint(Services.apply(map)));
 oper.addIfNotNull(getModuleConstraint(Modules.apply(map)));
 oper.addIfNotNull(getTestConstraint(Test.apply(map)));
 // or listFiles of
 oper.addIfNotNull(getTagList(Tags.apply(map)));
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;
 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getPackageConstraint(List<String> pack) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(pack)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : pack) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.PackagePrefixFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;

 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getServiceConstraint(List<String> pack) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(pack)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : pack) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.ServiceFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;

 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getModuleConstraint(List<String> pack) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(pack)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : pack) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.ModuleFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;

 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getTagList(List<String> tags) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(tags)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : tags) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.TagsFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;
 }

 public static final HTPredicate<TestCaseWrapper> getTestConstraint(List<String> tests) {
 if (ListUtil.nullOrEmpty(tests)) {
 return null;
 }
 LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper> oper = new LogicalOrOperator<TestCaseWrapper>();
 for (String p : tests) {
 oper.add(new com.hitorro.util.testframework.filters.TestNameRegexpFilter(p));
 }
 oper.finalizeFilter();
 return oper;
 }
}

## Summary - Updated Fix

I've corrected the setUp method to use the proper file. The issue was:

### Problem Found

**XMLBagLoader only handles XML files, not JSON!** The original fix tried to load `testbags.json`, but `XMLBagLoader` uses SAX parser which only works with XML files.

### Corrected Fix

Changed the setUp method to load `testbags.xmlprops` instead:

```java
@Override
protected void setUp() throws Exception {
 super.setUp();
 // Load test bags if not already loaded
 if (!bagsLoaded) {
 try {
 // Use the XML file, not JSON - XMLBagLoader only handles XML
 File bagsFile = this.getInputFileRelative("testbags.xmlprops");
 if (bagsFile != null && bagsFile.exists()) {
 XMLBagLoader loader = new XMLBagLoader();
 List<com.hitorro.util.typesystem.Bag> bags = loader.getBags(bagsFile, false);
 // Bags are automatically registered in TypeManager when loaded
 bagsLoaded = true;
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("Warning: Could not load testbags.xmlprops: " + e.getMessage());
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 }
}
```
